definitions.gloss: live action, real-life filming, live-action adaptation
definitions.explanation: Film or video using real actors and settings rather than animation or CGI. Frequently used when discussing adaptations of anime, manga, or games into live-action movies or TV series.

examples.japanese: {実写|じっしゃ}{映画|えいが}を{観|み}た。
{人気|にんき}マンガが{実写|じっしゃ}{化|か}される。
examples.english: A popular manga is getting a live-action adaptation.

examples.japanese: アニメの{実写|じっしゃ}{版|ばん}は{原作|げんさく}ファンの{間|あいだ}で{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}だった。
examples.english: The live-action version of the anime was divisive among fans of the original work.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in entertainment media discussions, especially regarding manga and anime adaptations. The suffix {化|か} is frequently attached: {実写|じっしゃ}{化|か} (live-action adaptation). Fans often debate the quality of {実写|じっしゃ}{版|ばん} (live-action versions) compared to the animated originals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実写|じっしゃ}{映画|えいが}: live-action movie
- {実写|じっしゃ}{化|か}: live-action adaptation
- {実写|じっしゃ}{版|ばん}: live-action version
- {実写|じっしゃ}ドラマ: live-action drama series
- {実写|じっしゃ}とアニメ: live action and animation
